title: THE BUSY TRAFFIC OUTSIDE A HONEYBEE HIVE
caption: Follow honeybees from flowers back to the busy hive entrance. Separate authentic archival clips, not one continuous journey. #Honeybee #Pollinators #Bees #WildVox Footage creators: Chixoy; The Nature Box; Alexanderboyes; Dennis.insect.filmer; Jerzystrzelecki; AnRo0002; BorekT. Original licenses: CC BY-SA 3.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0. Edits: excerpts, narration, subtitles, portrait framing. Adapted footage CC BY-SA 4.0 where required; source/credit/license details: github.com/lulualcides-sys/wildvox-automation/blob/main/qa/credits/2026-10-29.md

narration_timeline.text: Why does a honeybee hive look so busy from the outside?
narration_timeline.scene: Real exterior beehive entrance with bees.

narration_timeline.text: Some workers visit flowers to collect food, while others remain closer to home.
Foragers land on blossoms and gather nectar and pollen to carry back.
narration_timeline.scene: Three distinct authentic bees at flowers, including active close yellow-flower footage, without simulated flight.

narration_timeline.text: They may visit many flowers before making the return trip.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate authentic bee moving among small white flowers, not a hive-interior claim.

narration_timeline.text: Back at the hive, bees move through a narrow entrance in a steady stream.
narration_timeline.scene: Exterior hive boxes and entrances with bee movement, not an unshown wing-fanning claim.

narration_timeline.text: That busy traffic connects the flowers outside to the colony waiting within.
narration_timeline.scene: Close genuine bee traffic at the hive landing board; no claim that visible wings are fanning.
